data.define: Slang for food that tastes amazing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bussin' about a cold, bland sandwich.

data.l1_hook: Mamas Pasta schmeckt heute Abend unglaublich!

native.tip: “bussin” = mega lecker; hammer lecker; geil. Beispiel: “Mom's pasta is bussin tonight.”
